parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614146. Join activities to assays on assay_id and to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter where assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614146', activities.standard_value is not null, and activities.standard_relation = '='. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
